eventDetail.scope: RoMoCo focuses on advances in robot motion and control, bringing together researchers and practitioners working on the design, modeling, planning, sensing, and control of robotic systems. Its scope includes nonholonomic and underactuated robots, optimal and constrained control, multi-robot coordination, teleoperation, localization, perception, system identification, machine learning, robust and adaptive autonomy, safety, and human-robot cooperation. RoMoCo also covers control architectures, autonomous vehicles, robotic sensors and devices, and applications of robotics in agriculture, medicine, manufacturing, civil engineering, services, space, underwater, and aerial environments.
